room_rent.note: Basic plan: Single Private AC Room. Silver/Gold/Diamond: room category as per sum insured opted and policy schedule. Optional Room Rent Modification add-on available for Silver/Gold/Diamond to downgrade to Twin Sharing (with ₹500/day cash benefit) or upgrade with 20% co-pay.

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of inpatient treatment; no specific sub-limit or percentage cap mentioned in wording.

copayment.display: None (base); 20% if room upgraded above Twin Sharing (optional add-on); 10% deductible on Global Cover
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base plan. 20% co-pay applies only if Room Rent Modification add-on is opted and insured chooses room above Twin Sharing. Global Cover (Diamond only) has 10% deductible on sum insured per claim.

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments capped at 25% SI (Silver/Gold/Diamond) or 50% SI (Basic); Psychiatric illness sub-limit as per schedule
sub_limits.note: Modern treatments: 25% of SI for Silver/Gold/Diamond, 50% of SI for Basic plan. Psychiatric illness has a sub-limit as mentioned in policy schedule. No other explicit disease-wise sub-limits stated.

deductible.display: None (base); optional ₹25,000 or ₹50,000 aggregate deductible for Silver/Gold/Diamond
deductible.note: Base plan has no deductible. Optional aggregate deductible of ₹25,000 or ₹50,000 available for Silver/Gold/Diamond plans to reduce premium; once opted cannot be removed.

initial_waiting.note: First 30 days waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents. Waived if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 12 months via paid add-on for Silver/Gold/Diamond)
ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional 'Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period Waiver' add-on reduces it to 12 months for Silver/Gold/Diamond plans. Not available for Basic plan.

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (most conditions); 36 months (joint replacement, osteoporosis, HIV, ARMD, genetic disorders)
specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, stones, piles, fissures, skin disorders, renal failure, etc. 36-month list includes joint replacement (degenerative), osteoarthritis/osteoporosis, HIV, ARMD, genetic diseases.

maternity.display: Optional add-on (36-month wait); not available for Basic plan
maternity.note: Maternity cover is an optional paid add-on. 36-month waiting period applies from first policy inception. Limited to 2 living children. Sum insured as per policy schedule. Spouse must also be covered unless waived.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 200% (Diamond); up to 100% (Silver/Gold); not available for Basic
cumulative_bonus.note: Silver: 20% per claim-free year, max 100%. Gold: 50% per claim-free year, max 100%. Diamond: 50% per claim-free year, max 200%. Bonus lost in claim year but resumes next claim-free year. Alternatively, a premium discount option (NCD) is available.

restoration.note: Auto Restore Benefit restores up to 100% of base sum insured once per policy year upon complete or partial utilisation of base SI. Triggered by first admitted claim; available for subsequent claims. Unutilised restored amount not carried forward. Not available for Basic plan.

pre_hosp.display: As per policy schedule (days not specified in wording)
pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for number of days as mentioned in the policy schedule. Exact number of days not stated in the policy wording document.

post_hosp.display: As per policy schedule (days not specified in wording)
post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for number of days as mentioned in the policy schedule. Exact number of days not stated in the policy wording document.

day_care.note: Covers a defined list of day-care procedures as per Annexure I. OPD treatment on outpatient basis is not included.

domiciliary.display: Covered (Silver/Gold/Diamond); not covered for Basic plan
domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered if treatment exceeds 3 days and conditions under definition are met. Not applicable for Basic plan.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to the inpatient treatment sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals.

organ_donor.display: Covered (Silver/Gold/Diamond); not covered for Basic plan
organ_donor.note: Medical and surgical expenses of organ donor for harvesting covered when insured is the recipient. Not applicable for Basic plan.

ambulance.display: Covered up to limit in policy schedule (Silver/Gold/Diamond); not covered for Basic plan
ambulance.note: Road ambulance and inter-hospital transfer covered subject to limit specified in policy schedule. Not applicable for Basic plan. Air ambulance covered under Assistance Services (150+ km from home).

modern_treatments.display: Sub-limited: 50% of SI (Basic) or 25% of SI (Silver/Gold/Diamond)
modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, etc. Sub-limit applies: 50% of SI for Basic plan, 25% of SI for Silver/Gold/Diamond plans.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items covered via optional 'Non-Medical Items' add-on as per List 1 of Annexure 2, up to limit in schedule. Not available for Basic plan.

global_cover.display: Inbuilt for Diamond plan only (up to SI, 10% deductible, diagnosis must be in India)
global_cover.note: Global Cover available only under Diamond plan. Covers treatment outside India for up to 180 consecutive days. 10% deductible on SI applies per claim. Diagnosis must be made in India and referred by a medical practitioner.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Free look period of 30 days from date of receipt of policy document for new policies only; not applicable on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Request must be made at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD excluded (Basic/Silver/Gold); treatment outside India (non-Diamond); psychiatric illness sub-limited; specific ICD codes excluded per schedule disclosure

optional_riders.display: PED waiver (12mo), Maternity cover, Non-medical items, Hospital cash (Basic), Room rent modification, Aggregate deductible, Diabetes/Hypertension Day1 OPD (Diamond)
